newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE poised to demolish the 5,000 level.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE poised to demolish the 5,000 level.

text.p: Sufficient enthusiasm and drive exists in the stock market on Thursday to demolish the 5,000 barrier on the FTSE 100 index, technical analysts said.
Inspired by overnight strength on Wall Street, a buoyant mood in London should lift the FTSE today, they added.

The Dow made its 32nd record high so far this year and reached a milestone on Wednesday by closing above the 8,000 mark. If the Dow's assertiveness is not enough, the strength of European bourses should help take the FTSE up.
By 0715 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 1.5 at 4,965.7.
On Wednesday, the Dow closed up 63.17 at 8,038.88 while the Eurotrack 100 index of the top 100 European companies excluding those in the UK closed up 34.91 at a record high of 2,721.37.
In London today, shares in the financial sector and utilities should put in a positive performance while the pharmaceuticals may do less well, analysts said.

There could be some profit taking as the FTSE approaches the 5,000 region as is often the case as the market seeks to push past nice round numbers on the index. But market breadth for the FTSE has been improving this week and if this trend continues, the market should be able to withstand such downward pressure.
